hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י הַשְׁלִיכֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל הַ/יּוֹצֵ֔ר אֶ֣דֶר הַ/יְקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָקַ֖רְתִּי מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וָֽ/אֶקְחָ/ה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וָ/אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֹת֛/וֹ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶל הַ/יּוֹצֵֽר

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively

tokens.explanationEn: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively

tokens.bdb: amplitude, i.e. (concrete) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor
tokens.kjv: goodly, robe.

tokens.bdb: value, i.e. (concretely) wealth; abstractly, costliness, dignity
tokens.kjv: honour, precious (things), price.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit)
tokens.kjv: be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth
tokens.kjv: thirty, thirtieth. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

tokens.bdb: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
tokens.kjv: money, price, silver(-ling).

tokens.bdb: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
